title: Remote access — the simple setup, and the optional upgrade

steps.headline: The normal setup is finished and private, with nothing extra to do.
steps.changed: No certificate, no password prompt, no website step, nothing published about you. Your home wifi address stops answering — measured, not assumed.
steps.notice: Everything above Advanced is the panel you already know.

steps.headline: The upgrade says what it gives you, then what it costs, before you take it.
steps.changed: It leads with the gain — microphone, copy and font picker on your phone. Both levels are encrypted, so 'more secure' would be untrue. Then the permanent record.
steps.notice: Pairing keeps working while you decide. Nothing is published until you press the button.

steps.headline: Switched on, it reads as a setting — not as a finished wizard.
steps.changed: One row, one line saying what your phone can now do. It can be switched off again like any other setting.
steps.notice: Switching it off stops using the certificate; it cannot remove the public record.
